definition: to beat someone easily in a contest
description: A tug of war at a muddy country show on a grey day. A stocky young man in a dirty grey work shirt and khaki trousers leans far back and pulls hard on a thick rope wound around his body, his face tight with effort, as dust and churned mud fly around his boots. His opponents slip and fall onto their knees and into the dirt. He stands up straight, raises both fists in the air and roars. A crowd of people behind a rope barrier claps and cheers, and a big canvas tent and cattle pens stand in the background.

taps.phrase: to fall flat on his face
